item.title: Show HN: Poorleton – AI Generated Cycling Workouts
item.summary: Hello everyone, I recently got a used Peloton a couple of months ago for $200, but I didn't use it enough to justify $50/month for classes, so I vibe coded https://poorleton.fit/ over the weekend to have AI generated cycling classes. Let me know what you think. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49391976 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
